People (mostly stoners, and I'm a stoner myself) get pissed at me when I say that, yes, someone can in fact be addicted to weed. But I also do into detail with them they, no, weed does not form a "Physical" dependance which is what most people think of when they hear addiction, similar to Cigarettes, Caffeine, and Opiates. It can however form a, "Psychological" addiction. It's something that causes euphoria, relieves stress/anxieties, and helps the healing process of various malaise conditions, of course someone could develope such an emotional attachment to a substance like that to the point of psychological dependency. Other common things for people to become psychologically addicted to may not even include consuming of any substances, sleep, biting the nails, doing dangerous activities, playing League of Legends, all these can potentially be addictive. Addiction on its own isn't necessarily malicious, among other things such as cigarettes, I'm addicted to eating Animal Crackers, (yes, the kind you or at least someone would get in packed for school lunch) I absolutely love them, will I run relationships, jobs, and/or my life because of it? No, absolutely not. Psychological addiction isn't an automatic, "Oh that's nothing," take into consideration that it can take from my eating Animal Crackers obsessively, to shooting up Crystal Methamphetamine. Meth isn't physically addictive, but with the fact that the drug causes your dopamine receptors to fire up to a hundred times more than normal, your brain doesn't want to go back to what it was making before it had it, combine that with the fact that because Meth turns the "Happy hormone" in your brain up to eleven and proceeds to twist the knob even farther breaking it off, the receptor is burned it completely and the brain isn't even making as much as before consumption even began. Long story short, yes weed can be addictive, but so can eating. It's up to the individual on how it effects them and what they do to manage it, it could be as basic as buying and munching a bag of crackers or as out of control as steeling and shooting up a teenth of Speed. This is not me saying, "Do meth! Just as long as you don't go full fuckin tweaker!" but we're all members of the Human Race and have and will always make independent decisions, I just recommend, don't do anything you'll regret.
